```{python}
import numpy as np
# Monkey patch for np.string_ and np.unicode_ if they don't exist
if not hasattr(np, 'string_'):
    np.string_ = np.bytes_
if not hasattr(np, 'unicode_'):
    np.unicode_ = np.str_
import scanpy as sc
import glob
import os
import anndata as ad

# Path containing the .loom files (edit to your local path)
data_path = "path/to/velocyto_results"

# Directory where ALL new outputs will be saved (edit to your local path)
out_dir = r"path/to/velocyto_results_output"
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Auxiliary paths (edit to your local paths)
cell_names_path     = os.path.join(data_path, "cell_names.txt")
scvi_embeddings_csv = os.path.join(data_path, "scVI_embeddings.csv")
seurat_metadata_csv = os.path.join(data_path, "seurat_metadata.csv")
cell_type_meta_path = "path/to/cell_type_metadata.csv"

# Change to the data directory
os.chdir(data_path)

# List all .loom files
loom_files = glob.glob("*.loom")

adatas = []
for file in loom_files:
    sample_name = file.replace('.loom', '')
    
    # Read the loom file
    adata = sc.read_loom(file, sparse=True)
    
    # Update cell names to include the sample name
    adata.obs_names = [f"{cell}_{sample_name}" for cell in adata.obs_names]
    
    # Save original gene names (may not be unique)
    adata.var['original_gene'] = adata.var_names
    
    # Make gene names unique (required for merge)
    adata.var_names_make_unique()
    
    print(f"{file}: {adata.shape[0]} cells, {adata.shape[1]} genes")
    
    adatas.append(adata)

# Concatenate AnnData objects
combined_adata = ad.concat(
    adatas, 
    axis=0, 
    join='outer', 
    label="sample", 
    keys=[f.replace(".loom", "") for f in loom_files]
)

print(f"Combined AnnData: {combined_adata.shape[0]} cells, {combined_adata.shape[1]} genes")
print(combined_adata.obs_names[:5].tolist())

# Adjust cell names
combined_adata.obs_names = [
    name.split(":", 1)[1].replace("x_", "-1_") 
    for name in combined_adata.obs_names
]

import pandas as pd

# Read cell names from an external file
with open(cell_names_path, 'r') as f:
    cell_names = [line.strip() for line in f]

# Filter the AnnData keeping only cells present in the file
filtered_adata = combined_adata[combined_adata.obs_names.isin(cell_names)].copy()

print(filtered_adata)

# Comparison between cell sets
adata_cells = set(combined_adata.obs_names)
cell_names_set = set(cell_names)
common_cells = adata_cells & cell_names_set
unique_to_adata = adata_cells - cell_names_set
unique_to_cell_names = cell_names_set - adata_cells

print(f"Common cells: {len(common_cells)}")
print(f"Unique to combined_adata: {len(unique_to_adata)}")
print(f"Unique to cell_names: {len(unique_to_cell_names)}")

# Display some examples
unique_to_cell_names_sorted = sorted(unique_to_cell_names)
print("\n".join(unique_to_cell_names_sorted[:55]))

# Extract suffixes from the unique names
sufixos = [nome.split("-1_", 1)[1] for nome in unique_to_cell_names_sorted]
sufixos_unicos = sorted(set(sufixos))
print("Unique suffixes present in unique_to_cell_names:")
print("\n".join(sufixos_unicos))
```

# 0. External CSV statistics (before reindex)
csv_raw = pd.read_csv(cell_type_meta_path, index_col="barcode")

if n_only_adata > 0:
    only_adata_sorted = sorted(adata_barcodes - csv_barcodes)
    print("  Examples of AnnData barcodes missing in the CSV (first 5):")
    for b in only_adata_sorted[:5]:
        print(f"    {b}")

    suf_only_adata = sorted({b.split("-1_", 1)[1] for b in only_adata_sorted if "-1_" in b})

    print()

if n_only_csv > 0:
    only_csv_sorted = sorted(csv_barcodes - adata_barcodes)
    print("  Examples of CSV barcodes missing in AnnData (first 5):")
    for b in only_csv_sorted[:5]:
        print(f"    {b}")
    print()

# 2. NaN in cell_type_short after the merge
n_total   = filtered_adata.shape[0]
n_filled  = int(filtered_adata.obs["cell_type_short"].notna().sum())
n_missing = int(filtered_adata.obs["cell_type_short"].isna().sum())
print(f">>> In filtered_adata ({n_total} cells):")
print(f"  With cell_type_short:    {n_filled}")
print(f"  Without cell_type_short: {n_missing}")
print()

# 3. Cross-tab cell_type_group × cell_type_short (adipocytes only in group)
adipo_groups = ["White_adipocyte", "Brown_adipocyte", "PreAdipocyte"]
mask_adipo_group = filtered_adata.obs["cell_type_group"].isin(adipo_groups)
adipo_obs = filtered_adata.obs.loc[mask_adipo_group]

print(">>> cell_type_group among adipocytes (all cells in dataset):")
print(adipo_obs["cell_type_group"].value_counts(dropna=False))
print()

print(">>> cell_type_short among adipocytes (according to cell_type_group):")
print(adipo_obs["cell_type_short"].value_counts(dropna=False))
print()

print(">>> Cross-tab cell_type_group × cell_type_short (adipocytes):")
print(pd.crosstab(
    adipo_obs["cell_type_group"],
    adipo_obs["cell_type_short"].fillna("__NaN__"),
    dropna=False,
))

```{python}
import scvelo as scv
import scanpy as sc

# Basic preprocessing
scv.pl.proportions(filtered_adata)
scv.pp.filter_genes(filtered_adata, min_shared_counts=20)
scv.pp.normalize_per_cell(filtered_adata)
scv.pp.filter_genes_dispersion(filtered_adata, n_top_genes=10000)
scv.pp.log1p(filtered_adata)

# Compute neighbors using scVI embeddings and generate UMAP
sc.pp.neighbors(filtered_adata, n_neighbors=30, use_rep="X_scVI", n_pcs=None)
sc.tl.umap(filtered_adata)

# Moments and velocity
scv.pp.moments(filtered_adata)
scv.tl.velocity(filtered_adata)
scv.tl.velocity_graph(filtered_adata)

# Cell type counts
counts = filtered_adata.obs["cell_type_group"].value_counts()
counts.loc[["White_adipocyte", "Brown_adipocyte", "PreAdipocyte"]]
```


```{python}
# === Helper function to generate a velocity plot on a subset ===
# Imports guaranteed in this chunk (in case the Python state was reset)
import os
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
import scvelo as scv
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as path_effects
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pandas.core.arrays.categorical import CategoricalAccessor

# Silence scvelo DeprecationWarning (auto computation of PCA/neighbors)
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=DeprecationWarning, module="scvelo")
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=FutureWarning,    module="scvelo")

# Color palette for cell_type_short (used across the three plots)
adipocyte_palette = {
    "WAds":   "#ffe65a",
    "BAds":   "#97600f",
    "PreAds": "#a4c76d",
}

# Patch used by rank_velocity_genes in some pandas versions
@contextmanager
def temporary_categorical_patch():
    original = CategoricalAccessor._delegate_property_set
    def patched(self, name, new_values):
        if name == "categories":
            self._parent = self._parent.rename_categories(new_values)
            return
        return original(self, name, new_values)
    CategoricalAccessor._delegate_property_set = patched
    yield
    CategoricalAccessor._delegate_property_set = original


def plot_velocity_subset(adata_full, subset_mask, title, outfile,
                          color_key="cell_type_short",
                          palette=adipocyte_palette,
                          n_neighbors=15,
                          n_pcs=30):
    """
    Create a subset, recompute neighbors/UMAP/moments/velocity graph
    and generate the RNA velocity plot with annotated centroids.
    Saves the figure as a PDF at the provided path.
    """
    # Safety: local imports (in case the function is called in a fresh kernel)
    import os
    import numpy as np
    import scanpy as sc
    import scvelo as scv
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    import matplotlib.patheffects as path_effects

    sub = adata_full[subset_mask, :].copy()
    print(f"[{title}] initial subset: {sub.shape[0]} cells")
    if sub.shape[0] < 10:
        print(f"[{title}] subset too small, skipping.")
        return None

    # ---- Keep only cells whose cell_type_short is in the palette ----
    # (safety: the subset_mask should already ensure this, but if someone
    #  calls the function with a different mask, the filter below avoids
    #  a color-related KeyError)
    if color_key in sub.obs.columns and palette is not None:
        keep = sub.obs[color_key].isin(list(palette.keys()))
        n_drop = int((~keep).sum())
        if n_drop > 0:
            print(f"[{title}] dropping {n_drop} cells with {color_key} outside the palette")
        sub = sub[keep, :].copy()
        print(f"[{title}] subset after palette filter: {sub.shape[0]} cells")
        if sub.shape[0] < 10:
            print(f"[{title}] subset too small after palette filter, skipping.")
            return None

    # Make sure the color column is categorical with only the present classes
    if color_key in sub.obs.columns:
        sub.obs[color_key] = sub.obs[color_key].astype("category")
        sub.obs[color_key] = sub.obs[color_key].cat.remove_unused_categories()

    # Clear old colors that may be in .uns to avoid mismatches
    uns_color_key = f"{color_key}_colors"
    if uns_color_key in sub.uns:
        del sub.uns[uns_color_key]

    # Recompute neighbors on the subset, UMAP and velocity graph
    n_neigh = min(n_neighbors, max(2, sub.shape[0] - 1))
    sc.pp.neighbors(sub, use_rep="X_scVI", n_neighbors=n_neigh, n_pcs=30,
                    random_state=0)
    # Use flavor explicitly to avoid the leiden FutureWarning
    try:
        sc.tl.leiden(sub, key_added="scVI_clusters",
                     flavor="igraph", n_iterations=2, directed=False,
                     random_state=0)
    except TypeError:
        # Older scanpy versions don't support flavor='igraph'
        sc.tl.leiden(sub, key_added="scVI_clusters", random_state=0)
    sc.tl.umap(sub, random_state=0)

    scv.pp.moments(sub)
    scv.tl.velocity_graph(sub)

    with temporary_categorical_patch():
        try:
            scv.tl.rank_velocity_genes(sub, min_corr=0.3)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[{title}] rank_velocity_genes failed (non-critical): {e}")

    # Create the figure
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.4, 4.8), dpi=600)

    # Build the palette in the exact order of the present categories,
    # falling back to gray for any category without a defined color (it
    # shouldn't happen after the filter above, but it's an extra safety net).
    cats_in_order = list(sub.obs[color_key].cat.categories)
    palette_list = [palette.get(c, "#cccccc") for c in cats_in_order]

    # UMAP colored by cell_type_short with a custom palette
    sc.pl.umap(
        sub,
        color=color_key,
        palette=palette_list,
        legend_loc="right margin",
        title=title,
        show=False,
        ax=ax,
    )

    # Velocity arrows on top
    scv.pl.velocity_embedding_grid(
        sub,
        basis="umap",
        color=color_key,
        palette=palette_list,
        ax=ax,
        arrow_length=5,
        show=False,
        density=1,
        linewidth=0.5,
        arrow_size=1,
        smooth=1.5,
        min_mass=10,
        arrow_color="black",
        alpha=0.6,
    )

    # Centroid annotations
    cell_types = sub.obs[color_key].unique()
    for cell_type in cell_types:
        mask = sub.obs[color_key] == cell_type
        umap_coords = sub.obsm["X_umap"][mask.values] if hasattr(mask, "values") else sub.obsm["X_umap"][mask]
        if umap_coords.size == 0:
            continue
        x_centroid = np.median(umap_coords[:, 0])
        y_centroid = np.median(umap_coords[:, 1])
        ax.annotate(
            str(cell_type),
            (x_centroid, y_centroid),
            fontweight="bold",
            fontsize=10,
            color="black",
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            path_effects=[path_effects.withStroke(linewidth=3, foreground="white")],
        )

    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outfile, format="pdf", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.05)
    print("Saved to:", outfile)
    plt.show()
    plt.close(fig)
    return sub
```

# === Plot 1: ALL nuclei, only WAds + PreAds + BAds (cell_type_short) ===
selected_short = ["WAds", "PreAds", "BAds"]
mask_short = filtered_adata.obs["cell_type_short"].isin(selected_short)

outfile_1 = os.path.join(out_dir, "velocity_adipocytes_all.pdf")
adp_all = plot_velocity_subset(
    filtered_adata,
    subset_mask=mask_short,
    title="RNA Velocity – Adipocytes (all samples)",
    outfile=outfile_1,
)

```{python}
# === Diagnostic: compare the subsets used in Plot 2 and Plot 3 ===
# (check whether Dsubject3_BAT and neck_region == "Deep" pick the same cells
#  or if there is a bug)

# Inspect the unique values of both columns (only inside the adipocyte subset)
adipo_obs = filtered_adata.obs.loc[mask_short]

print(">>> Unique values of 'sample' in WAds/PreAds/BAds cells:")
print(adipo_obs["sample"].value_counts(dropna=False))
print()
print(">>> Unique values of 'neck_region' in WAds/PreAds/BAds cells:")
print(adipo_obs["neck_region"].value_counts(dropna=False))
print()

# Cross-tab: sample vs neck_region
print(">>> Cross-tab sample × neck_region (adipocytes only):")
print(pd.crosstab(adipo_obs["sample"], adipo_obs["neck_region"], dropna=False))
print()

# Direct comparison of the two masks
mask_sample = filtered_adata.obs["sample"] == "Dsubject3_BAT"
mask_deep   = filtered_adata.obs["neck_region"] == "Deep"

mask_plot2 = mask_short & mask_sample
mask_plot3 = mask_short & mask_deep

n2 = int(mask_plot2.sum())
n3 = int(mask_plot3.sum())
n_overlap   = int((mask_plot2 & mask_plot3).sum())
n_only_2    = int((mask_plot2 & ~mask_plot3).sum())
n_only_3    = int((~mask_plot2 & mask_plot3).sum())

print(f"Plot 2 (Dsubject3_BAT): {n2} cells")
print(f"Plot 3 (Deep):          {n3} cells")
print(f"  Overlap (in both):    {n_overlap}")
print(f"  Only in Plot 2:       {n_only_2}")
print(f"  Only in Plot 3:       {n_only_3}")

if n_only_2 == 0 and n_only_3 == 0:
    print("\n*** The two subsets are IDENTICAL — not a bug, they are literally "
          "the same cells. ***")
elif n_only_2 == 0:
    print("\n*** Plot 2 is contained in Plot 3. ***")
elif n_only_3 == 0:
    print("\n*** Plot 3 is contained in Plot 2. ***")
else:
    print("\n*** Different subsets — if the plots come out the same, there's "
          "another problem. ***")
```

# Full cross-tab: cell_type_short × cell_type_res.1.6
ct = pd.crosstab(
    filtered_adata.obs["cell_type_short"],
    filtered_adata.obs["cell_type_res.1.6"],
    dropna=False,
)
# Show only the columns that receive at least one cell from WAds, BAds or PreAds
mask_rows = ct.index.isin(["WAds", "BAds", "PreAds"])
mask_cols = (ct.loc[mask_rows].sum(axis=0) > 0)
print(ct.loc[mask_rows, mask_cols])
print()

# Direct check: does WAds match White_adipocyte_* exactly?
print(">>> For each short category, which cell_type_res.1.6 it contains:")
for short in ["WAds", "BAds", "PreAds"]:
    res16_vals = (
        filtered_adata.obs.loc[filtered_adata.obs["cell_type_short"] == short,
                               "cell_type_res.1.6"]
        .value_counts()
    )
    print(f"\n  {short}:")
    print(res16_vals[res16_vals > 0])

print("\n>>> And the reverse — which short does each White_*/Brown_*/PreAdipocyte_* point to?")
for prefix in ["White_adipocyte", "Brown_adipocyte", "PreAdipocyte"]:
    res16_cats = [
        c for c in filtered_adata.obs["cell_type_res.1.6"].cat.categories
        if str(c).startswith(prefix)
    ]
    for c in res16_cats:
        shorts = (
            filtered_adata.obs.loc[filtered_adata.obs["cell_type_res.1.6"] == c,
                                   "cell_type_short"]
            .value_counts()
        )
        shorts = shorts[shorts > 0]
        print(f"  {c}:  {dict(shorts)}")
